pdfcraft.body:
## What's Changed
* Print colour management: the app converts printed pictures into a printer profile (#6269) by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6853
* fix(render): an RGB colour in an isolated DeviceCMYK group blends in CMYK, as its ink by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7031
* prc: rebuild compressed tessellations whose normals are recalculated (#1297) by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7034
* Auto-tag Apply tags headings by size and weight (#7062) by @KenM76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7069
* feat: LaTeX animate playback — page actions, timers, getOCGs, view-only overrides (port of #4751) by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6985
* Reveal recent files in the system file manager from Home (#5452) by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5559
* fix(ui): Recognize Text's settings scroll in a short window, its buttons stay in reach (#6599) by @asadosteaksnl in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6760
* fix(js): each unit-test thread counts its own document script workers by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7051
* fix(hayro-syntax): a lone sign in a dictionary or array is unreadable, not a panic by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7053
* M7: a form edit reads the document's fields once (form.fill-text) by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7056
* fix(tests): saves compared byte for byte don't fail when the clock crosses a second between them by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7073
* fix(measure): read compound and fractional measurement number formats (ISO 32000-2 12.9.2) by @jonathanwxh-cell in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7115
* fix(optimize): a destination name given by reference is copied once however many dictionaries name it by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7035
* fix(sign): every signature's VRI entry shares the store's evidence arrays instead of copying them by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7038
* fix(forms): finding the first character a simple font cannot hold encodes the whole string once, then each distinct character once by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7047
* CI: use the shared git-sources check by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7042
* fix(ocr): main builds on Windows again (clippy needless_bool in program_is_executable) by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7222
* fix(startup): an OPENSSL_ia32cap naming a missing CPU feature no longer stops PdfCraft (#2916) by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7141
* test(ui): run the Home recent Reveal test inline so its toast check can't race by @Ethunxxx in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7202
* Link JavaScript actions and app.openDoc (port of #2081) by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7144
* export: migrate zip writer to craft-zip (#778) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7260
* Move remaining file formats and codecs to craft-libs (#778) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7261
* fix(ci): use pinned fonts for Sonar coverage by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4417
* M7: replacing a line keeps the source font for the words it can show (#2378, re-lands #2955) by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6842
* Fix macOS saves for PDFs with extended attributes by @christianlappin in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7203
* Cut over remaining codecs, xfa XML, and export packaging to craft-libs by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7326
* Move selected comments together with arrow keys by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7165
* fix(create): export JPEG images behind stream filters by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7168
* fix(ui): distinguish Insert Text annotation icon by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7170
* CI: preserve font notice regressions through shared gate by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7218
* i18n: move the craft-i18n pin to e56d262 by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7319
* fix(xfa): resolve clippy lints on main by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7354
* Tests: keep the update download test stable in Linux coverage by @christianlappin in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7350
* Create: decode PCX through craft-image-codecs by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7378
* Select a table by rows when a drag crosses its columns by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/3669
* i18n: move the craft-i18n pin to 866aff71 by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7417
* Handle fast optimization completion in picker test by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7422
* Export: write RTF through craft-rtf (storytold/craft-libs#793) by @kiwi5boy in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7374
* fix(web): open document links with noopener and send COOP same-origin (#5084) by @Higgs32584 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5091
* fix(render): cap a JPEG 2000 codestream's SIZ size at 2^28 pixels (#5078) by @Higgs32584 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5086
* sign: replace local BER/DER codec with existing craft-pkcs7 by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7447
* preflight: use shared ICC v2 sRGB output-intent bytes by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7450
* M2: a JPX image on a rotated page draws instead of crashing (#3884) by @jweaver3 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5438
* M3: select text across pages (view.text-select) by @TheSuperStew in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5017
* sign: replace local signature verification with existing craft-pkcs7 by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7475
* export: replace local Base64 encoder with existing craft-mime by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7449
* bs: Bosnian language support by @nine-codes in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5445
* Select the current query when refocusing search fields by @urbanij in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4533
* docs: bring ROADMAP.md and parity assessment current through 2026-11-15 by @gmrmad1 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7377
* Ctrl+M opens the Comments panel (#3741) by @AdrianTM in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/3762
* test(create): fail explicitly for invalid one-bit RGB fixtures by @MMexicann in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7344
* refactor(content): re-export craft_pdf::cos::content by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7529
* docs(prc-render): name the current craft-prc parser dependency by @MMexicann in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7330
* sign: use shared CMS SignedData signing writer by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7584
* docs: prefer shared craft-libs implementations by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7527
* fix(fonts): the licence policy reads name-table records one at a time within a total allowance by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7044
* fix(fonts): a CMap's codespace ranges are at most four bytes and listed once by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6075
* fix(platform): confine staging names; private temp dirs for tests and macOS signing by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5923
* fix(test): allow the unused mut on Windows in the private test folders by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7595
* Export: use shared extracted-text Markdown writer with exact output parity by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7591
* deny: ignore RUSTSEC-2026-0543, chrono unmaintained (#7647) by @Higgs32584 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7649
* M3: full screen fills the screen or keeps the page display, and Esc closes the find bar before leaving (#576, #4273, #5302) by @mtlcl410 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5325
* fix(render): resolve TrueType glyphs across Unicode/UCS-4 cmaps, post v2.0 aliases, and truncated FontFlags (#2159) by @jonathanwxh-cell in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2980
* fix(forms): name detected check boxes from the nearer neighbouring label (#2943) by @jonathanwxh-cell in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2953
* Bookmarks from text styles open at the heading top on turned pages by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7443
* Set Page Boxes crops the margin you type on UserUnit pages by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7445
* fix(xfdf): bound field text, look up names, guard tab cells, protect fields by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5937
* fix(ui): mirror the macOS title bar when the traffic lights are on the right (RTL system languages) by @Yousef-Dev921 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2186
* fix(ui): Edit ▸ Copy and Paste are enabled for selected comments (#7123) by @indy2kro in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7146
* Edit text: space between paragraphs by @regendorf-ux in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/1925
* M5.1: structural round-trip, property and never-crash tests for crates/annot (tests only) by @amoisttowe1 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2523
* fix(edit): preserve source fonts in mixed-script paragraphs by @PerchAnton in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2778
* Print: make a long printer list easier to browse and search (#4399) by @PerchAnton in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4436
* fix(xfa): render lines without width as vertical and without height as horizontal by @manurosado in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4588
* Keep the part of an email address before an apostrophe when redacting by @Silvertree2010 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/4652
* M12: forms show and add pages from page templates (#1429) by @Lcoding15 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5332
* M10: Recognize text finds small print on large pages (tiled detection) by @huppiflupp in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5401
* Tests: frame budgets scale with a calibration workload on slow machines by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5494
* fix(sign): a change to a field a signature locks invalidates it (#6757) by @Higgs32584 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6763
* fix(redact): redact an XObject or font whose /Subtype is a reference (#6750) by @Higgs32584 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6765
* fix(sign): an unlisted body or an entry that leads nowhere is no permitted change (#6754) by @Higgs32584 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6768
* fix(forms): draw field text the field font cannot hold from the bundled face instead of ? by @chamber074 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/6841
* Double-clicking a one-letter word selects only that word by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7425
* A hidden layer stays hidden after a full Save As by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7426
* Form-data import says when the form refused every value by @vangel76 in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7429
* fix(export): package a repeated picture once in PPTX and bound HTML embedded pictures by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/5933
* fix(xfdf): retain canonical Cargo lock package order by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7698
* test(annot): verify URL scan work independently of machine speed by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7695
* test(annot): retain current opacity and review-state semantics by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7721
* XFA: cache repeated prototype child counts without relaxing work limits by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7659
* Update annotation tests after SaveOptions, Style, LinkAction, and Shape changes by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7702
* Sign: use shared RFC 3161 request reader by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7637
* XFA: use shared namespace-aware XML DOM by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7642
* Sign: parse crl through shared PKCS7 components by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7654
* Sign: parse x509 through shared PKCS7 components by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7655
* XFDF: use shared bounded field-value reader by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7646
* Sign: parse ocsp through shared PKCS7 components by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7656
* Keep the DER tag import where the test oracles use it by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7783
* test(sign): keep embedded OCSP certificate oracle independent by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7786
* fix(sign): consume standard OCSP certificate wrapper parsing by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7795
* Use merged XFA namespace and BOM safety fixes by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7779
* test: avoid racing startup password completion order by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7811
* Export: Word through craft-docx, from the shared word model (rebased #7592) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7814
* ci: allow native gate cleanup to finish by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7805
* Cut over pptx export to craft-pptx by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7823
* Point hayro-postscript to storytold/craft-libs by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7828
* test(ui): await native button-script completion by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7825
* Restore plain PPTX tables and shared-writer regression checks by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7830
* Export: bound RTF pictures per placement, bake their rotations, report the pages that lose one by @kiwi5boy in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7572
* Issue #2385: audit finds thick strokes, black highlights and white boxes over text by @wstock in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2408
* export: isolate portable HTML and XFDF/FDF grammar by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7868
* create: share JPEG and JP2 embedding probes without re-encoding by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7902
* fonts: isolate Type0, CIDFont, ToUnicode, and FontDescriptor wire builders by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7911
* mcp: delegate stdio framing and JSON-RPC envelopes to craft-libs by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7910
* Fonts: the embedding tests import Stream by @dotCooCoo in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7916
* export, xfdf: cut over portable HTML writer and XFDF/FDF grammar to craft-libs (#778) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7914
* Restore JPEG metadata preflight parity by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7930
* create: use shared JPEG and JP2 embedding probes from craft-image-codecs (#778) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7939
* Route PDF parsing and rendering through shared craft-pdf by @skylartaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2068
* Adopt the shared AGENTS.md (RFC-0072) by @aiongg in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7937
* fonts: cut over encodings, Std14, and font wire builders to craft-pdf (#778) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7940
* create: restore tolerant Extended XMP preflight scanner by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7953
* Rename the open file from its tab (Rename… and double-click), with names that work on every system (#2102, #2867) by @regendorf-ux in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/2923
* fix(redact): refuse annotations with unreadable bounds by @rezaprama in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7180
* render: enforce max_coverage via craft-libs #2546 by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7961
* fix(ui): split view's active-pane line is drawn under open menus (#7010) by @indy2kro in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7147
* mcp: add stdio protocol transcript tests for initialize, cancel, and batch by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7969
* tests(fonts,render): add custom CMap wire and shared RasterOptions max_coverage parity tests by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7968
* test(rename): separate filename and full-path boundary fixtures by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/7965
* Release 0.22.0: retain the macOS signing keychain between steps by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/pdfcraft/pull/8111

photocraft.body:
## What's Changed
* fix(ui): keep the Color Sampler cursor while a sampler is dragged (#13063) by @RickiNano in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13212
* fix(ui): the Arbitrary angle rounds in f64 and keeps that value (#13067) by @RickiNano in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13217
* Remove tool: 19 px brush after Reset Tool and on first use by @rmsff in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13151
* Release: PhotoCraft v0.23.0 on main by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13345
* Remove: alert on a pixel layer with Lock All by @rmsff in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13171
* Pen: Undo after finishing a path gives it back to the Pen instead of deleting it (#6619) by @marmitoTH in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/6413
* ci: use StepSecurity's maintained actions by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13337
* macOS signing: decode the certificate into an exclusive temp file by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11028
* Place: refuse a scale that makes the placed image exceed the render pixel limit by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11229
* automation: save_bytes never reads linked files by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11233
* Escape control characters in log lines and diagnostic output taken from files and plug-ins by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11218
* text: charge the rasterizer's output tiles, not only its pixels by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11047
* fix(engine): apply the metadata choice to WebP Quick Export by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11058
* fix(compose): bisect gradient stops, evict oversized effect maps, skip empty distance transforms by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11056
* Camera Raw: read each source row once when building the preview proxy by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11064
* fix(cms): charge decoded CLUT values against a per-profile budget by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11055
* Save: a replacement in another group does not widen group access by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11232
* fix(ui-egui): bound the RAW re-read and treat symlinked names as taken in batch export by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11204
* fix(algo): hold raw filter parameters to their ranges (Water Paper, Box Blur, Lanczos, Camera Raw noise) by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11199
* fix(algo): bound EXIF text decoding, warp scans, gallery windows, inpaint sizes, pyramid depth by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11161
* codecs: list each Cryptomatte layer once and index streams by name by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10978
* fix(gpu): cap plan accumulator slots and gradient lookup tables by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11061
* fix(io): charge importers for the whole tiles surfaces keep by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11144
* fix(format,engine): limit zstd windows, set bundle modes via the handle, refuse symlinked presets by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11145
* fix(codecs): checked sizes in encoders, EXR name lookup, FITS float limit, VP8 plane copies, EXIF thumbnail bytes by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11164
* fix(engine): bound sparse remap, scaled clone sources, path reads, export format, name lookups by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11181
* fix(engine): authorization for nested scratch sessions and preset calls, CSV and PostScript text escaping by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11188
* Actions: charge skipped steps to the playback budget, bound batch nesting, clip the set override by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10969
* Engine: check dense working buffers against a budget before expanding sparse content by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/10964
* paint: refuse a sequential-dab stroke whose working copy is too large by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/11070
* CI: nightly release dry run by @FredApps in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13374
* Zoom tool: Zoom In / Zoom Out mode buttons (#12066) by @RickiNano in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13013
* Delete Anchor Point: Alt-click on an anchor selects its whole subpath by @rmsff in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13188
* Convert Point: drag a segment as Direct Selection does by @rmsff in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13141
* Freeform Pen: close a stroke only within 3 px of its start on each axis by @rmsff in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13313
* Line tool: Weight 1 px and 5 × 10 px arrowheads by default and after Reset Tool (#13241) by @RickiNano in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13305
* Count tool options bar: every control from the start in the reference order, tooltips and greying, scrubby size captions (#11765) by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/12206
* paint: two stroke tests check the result the stroke now returns by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13378
* Polygon tool: a rounded star rounds only its outer points (#13308) by @RickiNano in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13342
* Type options bar: Toggle Character and Paragraph panels button by @slafebre in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13020
* Line tool: a drag is one History step named "Line Tool" (#13244) by @NaufalDzz in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13303
* Delete Anchor Point keeps its path on the first Escape, and leaves a drag alone (#13072) by @Raghav2012Code in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13176
* Add Anchor Point: an anchor added to a straight segment is smooth, with handles (#12706) by @TrevorBrown-dev in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13215
* fix(ui): a Perspective Crop drag with no area keeps the clicked corners (#13065) by @Raghav2012Code in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13234
* ci: cap headless GPU backend tests with the nextest gpu group by @davidmann4 in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13257
* Perspective Crop: W, H and Resolution clamp to the measured ranges with alerts by @hectorviov in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/12237
* Fix Flatpak updates and bump to 0.23.1 by @dylanmtaylor in https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/pull/13322


**Full Changelog**: https://github.com/storytold/photocraft/compare/v0.23.0...v0.23.1
